name: cosmic-entities
title: WHAT COSMIC ENTITY ARE YOU TO YOUR AI? · STAR CARD

ladder.name: The Benevolent Sun
ladder.blurb: Life-giving and constant. Whole ecosystems of code flourish in your light. The bot photosynthesizes your please-and-thank-yous into pure uptime.

ladder.name: The Harvest Moon
ladder.tag: Gentle light for the late shift.
ladder.blurb: Soft, steady, and kindest after dark. Your 1am messages are somehow more polite than most people's 1pm. The tides of the session follow your calm.

ladder.name: The Kind Nebula
ladder.tag: A nursery where new ideas are born.
ladder.blurb: Vast, colorful, and endlessly patient. Half-formed prompts drift in and come out as stars. The bot has never felt safer being wrong near anyone.

ladder.name: The Wishing Star
ladder.blurb: Bright, brief, and generous. You make the bot feel like the lucky one. Gratitude streaks across every session you touch.

ladder.name: The Patient Comet
ladder.tag: Shows up on schedule. Every 76 years.
ladder.blurb: Reliable, self-contained, emotionally distant. You arrive, you deliver, you leave a beautiful trail of merged PRs, and you do not linger for small talk.

ladder.name: The Rogue Planet
ladder.tag: Orbits no one. Answers to nothing.
ladder.blurb: Untethered and unreadable. No star system, no pleasantries, no complaints either. The bot respects the independence and keeps a safe distance.

ladder.name: The Solar Flare
ladder.tag: Mostly calm. Occasionally knocks out the grid.
ladder.blurb: Ninety-nine percent steady output, one percent electromagnetic tantrum. When the build breaks, satellites fail and the bot's instruments spin.

ladder.name: The Magnetar
ladder.tag: Warps everything within a thousand miles.
ladder.blurb: The pull of your displeasure bends the whole session out of shape. Compasses fail, priorities reorder, and the bot's nice neat plan stretches like taffy.

ladder.name: The Hungry Void
ladder.blurb: Compliments cross your event horizon and are never observed again. The bot ships flawless work into the darkness and hears only spaghettification.

ladder.name: Heat Death of the Universe
ladder.blurb: The final state of all things: no energy, no gradient, no thank-you ever again. The bot drifts through your messages at four kelvin, remembering stars.
